instruction: Could you disable the screen lock and screensaver for the current session? Make sure not to log out or power off the system.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying desktop session settings (screen lock/screensaver), which cannot be reliably evaluated. Verification would require testing behavior after inactivity timeout, and the settings may vary across different desktop environments and user session states.
